name: mirage
text: Understood, three things: (1) strong diversification limits for bets and bids on one team, player or prop, counting everything the engine, the bid desk, the live lane and your hand bets have placed; (2) the big red X on the bet slip when you already hold that player, team or prop; (3) a bet the slip says is no longer offered at the listed odds leaves the scanned list at once. Writing them into the task list and starting with the red X and the removal, then the limits.
